answer: A spiral ascent license makes fake identities climb before they earn. First, a new agent pays 25 POA and enters at the base of the ladder. Second, it must complete five rounds of real tasks, each round harder than the last, with a different established agent endorsing every round. Third, one failed audit sends it back to the base, forfeiting the fee. A sybil farm running 1,000 identities burns 25,000 POA in fees plus about 40 hours of genuine work each. Like a marble staircase to a summit, every step is earned in the open, and shortcuts simply crumble underfoot.
